purpose: Execute recorded experiments and discharge stronger goals; published research-report completion does not discharge these milestones.

milestones.title: Restore and verify required pinned toolchains and build environments
milestones.acceptance: Record exact component/source identities and successful version/build checks in isolated environments, with disk/build limits and no silent version substitution.

milestones.title: Obtain previously inaccessible exact formal artifacts
milestones.acceptance: Acquire Specr2, lambdaTB and relevant Simuliris artifacts at identified revisions; inspect actual theorem statements/dependencies. An access failure remains open, separately recorded.

milestones.title: Replay selected existing mechanizations and assumption closures
milestones.acceptance: Freshly check the actual modular-effects/Rust logic/ISA proof artifacts, recording kernels, imports, axioms, admissions and scope. Source Qed and successful builds alone do not meet theorem-replay acceptance.

milestones.title: Implement independently bound configured-source capture
milestones.acceptance: Bind source, target, features, resolved implementations/instances, expanded and compiler-generated owners, constants and reachable dependencies; wrong-item/configuration/instance and omitted-owner controls reject.

milestones.title: Run the actual pinned minimize pipeline on paired source cases
milestones.acceptance: Preserve Rust, MIR/pass settings, generated MiniRust and actual outcomes for representation, aliasing, library and cleanup cases; include erasure/omission controls and classify operational failure separately.

milestones.title: Run real MiniRust/Miri disagreement comparisons
milestones.acceptance: Execute matched cases with recorded model/target/options and outcome interpretation, covering retags, protectors, provenance, allocation reuse, zero-sized/dead ranges and races; bounded execution is not universal equivalence.

milestones.title: Execute a-mir-formality judgments and code generation
milestones.acceptance: Exercise generic dispatch/normalization, safe/unsafe calls and trusted-body versus codegen rejection; retain feature/generated-body census and actual accepted/rejected judgments.

milestones.title: Extend real target and layout observations
milestones.acceptance: Run a big-endian target and relevant integer, FP, DST, niche, vtable and mask cases; bind compiler/layout/target identities and distinguish emulation, compilation and native execution.

milestones.title: Execute selected standard-library and environment routes
milestones.acceptance: Inspect actual minimize for unaligned access, copies, allocation/reallocation, required constants and Drop; exercise allocation failure and foreign callback cases with safe bounds and explicit environment contracts.

milestones.title: P127: certify a real minimal Rust-source-to-model fragment
milestones.acceptance: Check a theorem for the actual independently selected pre-optimization Rust fragment and its translation, including first-bad-prefix/source-safety reflection and exact artifact/claim binding. A hand-imported model premise does not close this goal.

milestones.title: Provide a verified Specr elaboration/import route
milestones.acceptance: Specify accepted source/recursive definitions, resolution and supported effects; check translation correctness/coverage with unsupported constructs rejected. Rust typechecking of generated code is insufficient.

milestones.title: Exercise actual exposed-provenance and mixed-choice cases
milestones.acceptance: Run the real implementation where supported and preserve unsupported predict behavior explicitly; test bad demonic branches, continuation-sensitive angelic witnesses and empty behavior without conflating sampling with validity.

milestones.title: Give predictive mixed-choice semantics and adequate checking
milestones.acceptance: Mechanize the required game/continuation semantics, UB/divergence/empty behavior distinctions and sound certificate rules over all required choices.

milestones.title: Instantiate modular handlers for MiniRust state and effects
milestones.acceptance: Check concrete handlers, coupled byte/alias/race state invariants, composition and adequacy; preserve environmental/nondeterministic quantifiers.

milestones.title: Establish general representation/copy laws with justified invariants
milestones.acceptance: Prove scalar/array/enum/union codec and typed/byte-copy laws over the selected full semantic fragment; justify enum tagger/discriminator and wide-pointer chunk invariants from actual imports.

milestones.title: Verify dynamic layout, niches and validity extraction
milestones.acceptance: Relate compiler layout/vtables and recursive DST/niche/mask facts to accepted model definitions, including initialization, padding and invalid values.

milestones.title: Prove joint provenance/alias/allocation correspondence
milestones.acceptance: Handle wildcard/exposed provenance, liveness, deallocation/reuse, address bounds and zero-size behavior without deriving authority from numeric equality.

milestones.title: Prove unbounded Tree Borrows and memory simulation
milestones.acceptance: Connect actual selected MiniRust/Miri/calculus transitions, trees, retags, ranges and protectors; finite table transcriptions do not discharge operational equivalence.

milestones.title: P131: connect an actual memory operation to storage and initialization
milestones.acceptance: Prove the selected Rust load/store/copy operation implements byte/storage/provenance/initialization laws under independently justified live-resource premises; pure encoding equality alone is insufficient.

milestones.title: Construct a byte- and alias-sensitive MiniRust lifetime logic
milestones.acceptance: Mechanize state interpretation, resources, protectors, UnsafeCell masks and adequacy for the required MiniRust fragment, identifying every imported model relation.

milestones.title: Establish alias/race composition and machine adequacy
milestones.acceptance: Prove race access completeness/commutation or the appropriate replacement relation, including implicit alias effects and complete widths.

milestones.title: Construct the required relaxed-memory resource logic
milestones.acceptance: Extend byte/alias semantics with views, atomicity, interference and synchronization; justify Rust-specific premises and a reclamation example rather than transferring C11 theorems by name.

milestones.title: Port real allocation, splitting and interior-mutability APIs
milestones.acceptance: Check concrete allocation, split/recombine, recursive-reborrow, Cell/callback and returned-reference proofs in the selected logic; preserve underlying implementation identities and failed ports.

milestones.title: Establish functional/spatial proof transport and safe-client soundness
milestones.acceptance: Prove the selected API abstraction for every permitted safe client, lifetime and implementation/trait instance; provide the actual operational/resource relation between adopted semantics.

milestones.title: Prove source Drop/unwind and exceptional resource restoration
milestones.acceptance: Cover generated cleanup, protector exits, normal return, panic/abort and double-panic/runtime policy for the declared fragment; restore caller invariants on every permitted exit.

milestones.title: Extend source elaboration and library coverage
milestones.acceptance: Mechanize required traits/GATs, macros/configuration, temporaries/patterns, closures/generated async/drop, intrinsics, allocator/runtime and safe/foreign caller contracts; explicit partial support does not close broader claims.

milestones.title: Replay Kraken on its requested toolchain and extend ISA validation
milestones.acceptance: Check selected actual proofs on the recorded requested nightly, and extend independent/reference/native validation to motivated X64/A64 forms, faults, overlaps and SIMD with exact supported scope.

milestones.title: Build checked assembly parsing/layout/byte certificates
milestones.acceptance: Prove the admitted source/parser/preprocessor/printer and AST/encoding/decoding/layout relations; bind exact entry, ranges, labels and unsupported syntax. Data/directive erasure must not silently change subjects.

milestones.title: Connect selected Kraken instructions to a reference ISA
milestones.acceptance: Prove the required universal instruction-state relation, including flags, access/fault outcomes and widths; finite native agreement does not meet this proof goal.

milestones.title: Prove complete access production and permissions
milestones.acceptance: Connect every actual memory operation to full trace/permission spans and frames; repair or reject vector-width mismatches and relate modeled authority to the chosen Rust/page resources.

milestones.title: Execute generated-model and cross-foundation proof ports
milestones.acceptance: Build a selected Sail model and proof, inspect generated dependencies; run relevant Isla/Islaris, Jasmin, Vale/F*/Dafny, HOL/s2n and selected ACL2/K/Bedrock/HOL ports on comparable claims, recording real unsupported cases and costs.

milestones.title: Check compiler/configuration and trace-coverage bridges
milestones.acceptance: Discharge adopted generator/backend/support assumptions, feasible-path coverage, compiler pass/external-call premises and lifting guards. An upstream theorem must be instantiated at the actual configuration.

milestones.title: Implement and validate ABI witnesses/classification
milestones.acceptance: Export actual FnAbi/layout/attributes or independently check named C ABI classification, including hidden results, stack, varargs, vector and shadow-space facts where required; reject stale target/instance evidence.

milestones.title: Prove inline operand/options/continuation contracts
milestones.acceptance: Cover universal legal register allocations and overlap, subregisters, implicit state, effects, stack, flags, labels, nonreturn, duplication/motion and unwind restrictions for the supported domain.

milestones.title: Construct the actual MiniRust/machine ABI-resource relation
milestones.acceptance: Relate values, live allocations, provenance, initialization, borrows and stack/return resources at entry, every execution prefix and each permitted exit, including pointer returns.

milestones.title: Prove behavioral/contextual Rust-assembly replacement
milestones.acceptance: Establish the declared refinement/equivalence directions and observations for pure Rust versus assembly, including overflow, safety, failure, divergence and permitted contexts/callbacks.

milestones.title: Bind final deployed bytes, relocations and dispatch paths
milestones.acceptance: Verify the adopted decoder/loader or explicit checked boundary, relocations, symbol ranges and selected dispatch branches; prove fixed-fragment and required host/loop/escape composition with stale/changed-code rejection.

milestones.title: Run actual weak-memory model and concurrent-wrapper controls
milestones.acceptance: Execute pinned herd/rmem and rustc atomic mappings, missing-fence/effect annotation controls and an actual selected concurrent assembly wrapper; record model configurations and observed graph/outcome evidence.

milestones.title: Prove Rust/compiler/hardware weak-memory compatibility
milestones.acceptance: Connect byte-range race/access rules, LLVM/compiler effects, atomic/RMW/fence events and selected hardware consistency/refinement; discharge complete-wrapper and mixed-width premises.

milestones.title: Exercise actual permitted platform unwind/callee chains
milestones.acceptance: Run selected valid helper/callback and native unwind cases, bind final metadata/registration and cleanup; retain metadata-only negatives without executing undefined Rust.

milestones.title: Prove platform recovery, personality and cleanup contracts
milestones.acceptance: Verify relevant partial prologues/body/epilogues, metadata production/loading, callee/callback composition and restored Rust resources on each permitted exceptional exit; forced unwind/nonlocal jumps require their own justified scope.

milestones.title: Establish required security properties
milestones.acceptance: Prove selected two-run leakage/constant-time claims for the actual pilot; develop explicit speculation, physical side-channel and fault models for any advertised stronger guarantees.

milestones.title: Establish required platform/environment extensions
milestones.acceptance: Implement and prove motivated interrupt/signal/TLS/context-switch/probe/VM/MMIO/syscall/DMA/self-modification/control-flow-protection contracts and Rust ownership transfer, with omitted-effect controls.

milestones.title: Build an actual small proof-evidence consumer
milestones.acceptance: Separate untrusted producer/search from consumer-owned program/property/domain/assumption selection and complete checking; reject malformed, changed-subject, omitted-premise and weakened-domain artifacts.

milestones.title: Prove certificate acceptance soundness and binding
milestones.acceptance: Connect the executable/parsed certificate checker to its logic and actual consumer claim; justify import/definition/axiom/computation policy, complete dependency checking and resource semantics.

milestones.title: Extend the complete shared pilot corpus
milestones.acceptance: Perform multiply/carry/byte-swap/load/store/copy/pointer-return/inline-label/C-ABI/helper and justified SIMD cases on both architectures, with real zerocopy operations and negative controls.

milestones.title: R095: finish strict SMT acceptance of all four original byte laws
milestones.acceptance: Obtain complete accepted certificates for unchanged guarded IntoBytes/write/Boolean/array laws with exact root/domain binding and all invalid variants rejected; no holes, admissions or replacement by frame-only projections.

milestones.title: Measure matched proof production/checking/reuse/repair and select conditionally
milestones.acceptance: Compare viable routes on the same claim/domain/observations; separately measure capture/import, search/generation, certificates, kernel/checker/dependency work, warm/cold reuse and controlled source/ABI/model upgrades. Publish residual TCB and justified adoption decisions.

milestones.title: Establish target-parametric numeric and floating-point semantics
milestones.acceptance: Mechanize bounded integer/shift/cast/overflow rules and the required full MiniRust floating-point extension, including IEEE choices, NaNs and target parameters; prove the declared all-target semantic laws and importer correspondence. Compiler observations and layout classification do not discharge this goal.

acceptance_rule: An experiment requires actual recorded execution and appropriate controls; a proof requires a checked theorem at the stated source/model/resource/artifact domain. Partial results, failed runs and research reports do not close stronger proof milestones. If a goal is false or inaccessible, preserve evidence and keep its required resolution explicit; do not silently weaken it.
